question: In 2025, which male field athlete joined Usain Bolt as the only track‑and‑field winners of Laureus Sportsman of the Year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mondo Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mondo Duplantis**, a Swedish-American pole vaulter, joined **Usain Bolt** as one of the only male track-and-field athletes to win the **Laureus Sportsman of the Year Award** in **2025**. This prestigious award recognizes exceptional achievements in sports globally.
 
• Duplantis is known for his dominance in pole vaulting, breaking multiple **world records**. As of **2025**, he holds the record of vaulting **6.23 meters**, set in **2023**.
 
• The **Laureus World Sports Awards** were established in **2000** to celebrate and honor outstanding athletes, teams, and sports achievements across the world.
 
• Duplantis has been widely regarded as one of the most consistent performers in athletics, with numerous **gold medals** in events like the **Olympics**, **World Championships**, and **European Championships**.
 
• He became the second male track-and-field athlete after **Usain Bolt**—an eight-time Olympic gold medalist and world-record holder in the 100m and 200m sprints—to win this prestigious accolade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mondo Duplantis:**

 
 
• Full name: **Armand Gustav "Mondo" Duplantis**.
 
• Born on **November 10, 1999**, in **Lafayette, Louisiana, USA**.
 
• He represents **Sweden** internationally, as his mother is Swedish, while his father was an elite pole vaulter in the United States.
 
• Duplantis has been breaking records since his teenage years, first setting a **world junior record** at the age of 18.
 
• Known for his innovative techniques, speed, and agility, he has brought significant attention to the sport of pole vaulting.
 
 
 
• **Usain Bolt:**
 
 
• Widely regarded as the greatest sprinter of all time, Bolt won the **Laureus Sportsman of the Year Award** four times: in **2009, 2010, 2013,** and **2017**.
 
• He holds **world records** in the 100m (9.58 seconds) and 200m (19.19 seconds), set in **2009**.
 
• His dominance in athletics inspired generations of athletes and significantly raised the global profile of track-and-field sports.
 
 
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**
 
 
• Established in **2000**, these awards are often referred to as the "Oscars of Sports."
 
• They honor individuals and teams from across the globe for their outstanding performances and contributions to sports.
 
• The winners are selected by the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, a group of the world’s greatest living sports legends.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Nominees in 2025:**
 
 
• **Carlos Alcaraz**: A Spanish tennis player known for his rapid rise in the ATP rankings and Grand Slam victories.
 
• **Max Verstappen**: A Dutch Formula 1 driver, known for consecutive World Championship wins with the **Red Bull Racing** team.
 
• **Novak Djokovic**: A Serbian tennis legend who has dominated men’s tennis with a record-breaking number of **Grand Slam titles**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mondo Duplantis's Achievements:**

 
 
• Set the **current world record** of **6.23 meters** in pole vaulting in **2023**.
 
• Won **gold medals** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**, and the **2022 and 2023 World Championships**.
 
• He has been unbeaten in numerous competitions, showcasing unparalleled consistency in his discipline.
 
 
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards History:**
 
 
• The awards have recognized sports legends like **Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, Lionel Messi, Michael Schumacher,** and **Tiger Woods**.
 
• The **Sportsman of the Year Award** is considered one of the highest accolades in the world of sports.
 
• The awards aim to celebrate excellence, inspire future generations, and promote sports as a tool for social change.
